      const reduced = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
      const dots = Array.from({ length: 36 }, (_, i) => ({
        x: (i * 0.6180339887) % 1,
        y: (i * 0.3819660113) % 1,
        r: 1 + (i % 3) * 0.65,
        speed: 0.008 + (i % 5) * 0.004,
        phase: i * 0.7,
      }));
      function resize() {
        const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
        canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.floor(window.innerWidth * dpr));
        canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.floor(window.innerHeight * dpr));
        ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
      }
      resize();
      window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
      function draw(ts) {
        const t = ts * 0.001;
        const w = window.innerWidth;
        const h = window.innerHeight;
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
        for (const d of dots) {
          const px = ((d.x + (reduced ? 0 : t * d.speed * 0.2)) % 1) * w;
          const py = ((d.y - (reduced ? 0 : t * d.speed * 0.12) + 1) % 1) * h;
          const alpha = 0.2 + 0.28 * Math.sin(d.phase + (reduced ? 0 : t * 0.9));
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(186, 230, 253, ${alpha.toFixed(3)})`;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(px, py, d.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        }
        if (!reduced) requestAnimationFrame(draw);
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(draw);

#!/bin/sh
# piloti — Piloti Desktop CLI & Wayland session launcher
set -eu

PILOTI_VERSION="0.10.1"
PILOTI_SHARE_DIR="${PILOTI_SHARE_DIR:-/usr/share/piloti-desktop}"
PILOTI_SHELL_BUNDLE="${PILOTI_SHELL_BUNDLE:-${PILOTI_SHARE_DIR}/shell.js}"
PILOTI_DEFAULT_CONFIG="${PILOTI_DEFAULT_CONFIG:-${PILOTI_SHARE_DIR}/domicile.json}"

resolve_domicile_sock() {
  if [ -n "${DOMICILE_SOCK:-}" ] && [ -S "${DOMICILE_SOCK}" ]; then
    return 0
  fi
  runtime_dir="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}"
  if [ -d "${runtime_dir}" ]; then
    # Pick the most recently modified domicile IPC socket for this user.
    sock="$(ls -t "${runtime_dir}"/domicile-ipc.*.sock 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 || true)"
    if [ -n "${sock}" ] && [ -S "${sock}" ]; then
      DOMICILE_SOCK="${sock}"
      export DOMICILE_SOCK
      return 0
    fi
  fi
  return 1
}

require_domicile() {
  if ! command -v domicile >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "piloti: 'domicile' executable not found in PATH" >&2
    exit 127
  fi
}

send_shell() {
  require_domicile
  resolve_domicile_sock || true
  exec domicile send-shell "$@"
}

print_help() {
  cat <<EOF
piloti ${PILOTI_VERSION} — Piloti Desktop CLI & Wayland session launcher

Usage:
  piloti [session|start] [domicile args...]   Start Piloti Desktop via Domicile
  piloti greeter [domicile args...]           Start Piloti Display Manager greeter
  piloti reload [shell.js]                    Hot-reload shell into running session
  piloti which-shell                          Print active Domicile shell path
  piloti open [--app] <app|url|file> [arg]    Open built-in app, URL, or file
  piloti settings [pane]                      Open Desktop Settings (optional pane)
  piloti launcher | overview                  Toggle Launcher or Overview
  piloti screenshot [file]                    Take screenshot
  piloti record                               Toggle screen recording
  piloti lock | logout | restart | poweroff   Session & power controls
  piloti add|install <url>                    Install Web App (.desktop)
  piloti del|remove|uninstall <url|id>        Remove installed Web App
  piloti list                                 List installed Piloti Web Apps
  piloti send <word...>                       Send raw command to running shell
  piloti --version | --help                   Show version or this help
EOF
}

list_webapps() {
  apps_dir="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-${HOME}/.local/share}/applications"
  found=0
  if [ -d "${apps_dir}" ]; then
    for f in "${apps_dir}"/piloti-webapp-*.desktop; do
      [ -f "${f}" ] || continue
      found=1
      name="$(sed -n 's/^Name=//p' "${f}" | head -n 1)"
      url="$(sed -n 's/^Exec=piloti-webapp[[:space:]]*//p' "${f}" | head -n 1)"
      printf '%-24s %s\n' "${name:-$(basename "${f}" .desktop)}" "${url}"
    done
  fi
  if [ "${found}" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "No web apps installed."
  fi
}

link_prebuilt_cache() {
  sys_cache="/var/cache/piloti-desktop/shells"
  [ -d "${sys_cache}" ] || return 0
  user_cache="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-${HOME}/.cache}/domicile/shells"
  mkdir -p "${user_cache}" 2>/dev/null || return 0
  for entry in "${sys_cache}"/*; do
    [ -d "${entry}" ] || continue
    base="$(basename "${entry}")"
    [ -e "${user_cache}/${base}" ] || ln -s "${entry}" "${user_cache}/${base}" 2>/dev/null || true
  done
}

cleanup_orphaned_engine() {
  # If no live `domicile` supervisor is running for this user, terminate any
  # orphaned engine/compositor left behind by a killed previous session so
  # Chromium's profile SingletonLock cannot block login ("Opening in existing
  # browser session.").
  uid="$(id -u)"
  if command -v pgrep >/dev/null 2>&1 && ! pgrep -u "${uid}" -x domicile >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if pgrep -u "${uid}" -f "[/]usr/libexec/domicile/engine/chrome|[/]usr/bin/domicile-compositor" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      pkill -TERM -u "${uid}" -f "[/]usr/libexec/domicile/engine/chrome" 2>/dev/null || true
      pkill -TERM -u "${uid}" -f "[/]usr/bin/domicile-compositor" 2>/dev/null || true
      i=0
      while [ "${i}" -lt 10 ]; do
        pgrep -u "${uid}" -f "[/]usr/libexec/domicile/engine/chrome|[/]usr/bin/domicile-compositor" >/dev/null 2>&1 || break
        sleep 0.1
        i=$((i + 1))
      done
      pkill -KILL -u "${uid}" -f "[/]usr/libexec/domicile/engine/chrome" 2>/dev/null || true
      pkill -KILL -u "${uid}" -f "[/]usr/bin/domicile-compositor" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
  fi
}

start_session() {
  require_domicile
  link_prebuilt_cache
  cleanup_orphaned_engine
  export XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP="${XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP:-Piloti:GNOME}"
  export XDG_SESSION_DESKTOP="${XDG_SESSION_DESKTOP:-piloti}"
  export DESKTOP_SESSION="${DESKTOP_SESSION:-piloti}"
  export XDG_SESSION_TYPE="${XDG_SESSION_TYPE:-wayland}"

  # Piloti keeps its own Domicile config so the plain "Domicile" session
  # (which reads ~/.config/domicile) keeps launching Domicile's default shell.
  # First run: seed it from a previous Piloti-era ~/.config/domicile file when
  # that one names a Piloti shell, otherwise from the packaged defaults.
  piloti_config="${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-${HOME}/.config}/piloti/domicile.json"
  old_config="${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-${HOME}/.config}/domicile/domicile.json"
  if [ ! -f "${piloti_config}" ]; then
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "${piloti_config}")"
    if [ -f "${old_config}" ] && grep -q 'piloti' "${old_config}" 2>/dev/null; then
      cp "${old_config}" "${piloti_config}"
    elif [ -f "${PILOTI_DEFAULT_CONFIG}" ]; then
      cp "${PILOTI_DEFAULT_CONFIG}" "${piloti_config}"
    fi
  fi

  if [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; then
    exec domicile "${PILOTI_SHELL_BUNDLE}" "$@"
  elif [ -f "${piloti_config}" ]; then
    exec domicile "${PILOTI_SHELL_BUNDLE}" --config "${piloti_config}"
  else
    exec domicile "${PILOTI_SHELL_BUNDLE}"
  fi
}

sub="${1:-session}"
if [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; then
  shift
fi

case "${sub}" in
  help|--help|-h)
    print_help
    ;;
  version|--version|-v)
    echo "piloti-desktop ${PILOTI_VERSION}"
    ;;
  session|start)
    start_session "$@"
    ;;
  greeter)
    exec /usr/bin/piloti-greeter "$@"
    ;;
  reload)
    require_domicile
    resolve_domicile_sock || true
    target="${1:-${PILOTI_SHELL_BUNDLE}}"
    exec domicile load-shell "${target}"
    ;;
  which-shell)
    require_domicile
    resolve_domicile_sock || true
    exec domicile which-shell
    ;;
  open)
    if [ "$#" -eq 0 ]; then
      echo "piloti open: app id, URL, or file path required" >&2
      exit 2
    fi
    send_shell open "$@"
    ;;
  settings)
    send_shell settings "$@"
    ;;
  launcher|overview|lock|logout|restart|poweroff|record)
    send_shell "${sub}" "$@"
    ;;
  screenshot)
    if [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; then
      require_domicile
      resolve_domicile_sock || true
      exec domicile screenshot "$@"
    fi
    send_shell screenshot
    ;;
  add|install)
    if [ "$#" -eq 0 ]; then
      echo "piloti install: URL required" >&2
      exit 2
    fi
    send_shell install "$@"
    ;;
  del|remove|uninstall)
    if [ "$#" -eq 0 ]; then
      echo "piloti remove: URL or app ID required" >&2
      exit 2
    fi
    send_shell remove "$@"
    ;;
  list)
    list_webapps
    ;;
  send)
    if [ "$#" -eq 0 ]; then
      echo "piloti send: command arguments required" >&2
      exit 2
    fi
    send_shell "$@"
    ;;
  *)
    echo "piloti: unknown subcommand '${sub}' (try 'piloti help')" >&2
    exit 2
    ;;
esac

#!/bin/sh
# piloti-greeter — Standalone Display Manager greeter launcher for greetd
set -eu

PILOTI_SHARE_DIR="${PILOTI_SHARE_DIR:-/usr/share/piloti-desktop}"
PILOTI_GREETER_BUNDLE="${PILOTI_GREETER_BUNDLE:-${PILOTI_SHARE_DIR}/greeter.js}"
PILOTI_GREETER_CONFIG="${PILOTI_GREETER_CONFIG:-${PILOTI_SHARE_DIR}/greeter-domicile.json}"

if ! command -v domicile >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "piloti-greeter: 'domicile' executable not found in PATH" >&2
  exit 127
fi

if [ -d /var/cache/piloti-desktop/shells ]; then
  user_cache="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-${HOME}/.cache}/domicile/shells"
  mkdir -p "${user_cache}" 2>/dev/null || true
  for entry in /var/cache/piloti-desktop/shells/*; do
    [ -d "${entry}" ] || continue
    base="$(basename "${entry}")"
    [ -e "${user_cache}/${base}" ] || ln -s "${entry}" "${user_cache}/${base}" 2>/dev/null || true
  done
fi

export XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP="Piloti:GNOME"
export XDG_SESSION_TYPE="wayland"
export PILOTI_GREETER="1"

# Clear any orphaned greeter engine/compositor holding SingletonLock
uid="$(id -u)"
if command -v pgrep >/dev/null 2>&1 && ! pgrep -u "${uid}" -x domicile >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if pgrep -u "${uid}" -f "[/]usr/libexec/domicile/engine/chrome|[/]usr/bin/domicile-compositor" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    pkill -TERM -u "${uid}" -f "[/]usr/libexec/domicile/engine/chrome" 2>/dev/null || true
    pkill -TERM -u "${uid}" -f "[/]usr/bin/domicile-compositor" 2>/dev/null || true
    sleep 0.2
  fi
fi

# Build a runtime greeter config that honors the system keyboard layout from
# /etc/default/keyboard (first keymap = default) and exposes named layouts so
# the top-bar selector can switch live via domicile.keyboard.selectKeymap().
RUNTIME_GREETER_CONFIG="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/tmp}/piloti-greeter-domicile.json"
if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if python3 - "${PILOTI_GREETER_BUNDLE}" "${RUNTIME_GREETER_CONFIG}" <<'PY' 2>/dev/null
import json, os, re, sys

bundle, out_path = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
kb = {}
for cfg_path in ("/etc/default/keyboard",):
    if os.path.isfile(cfg_path):
        with open(cfg_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as f:
            for line in f:
                m = re.match(r'^\s*(XKB\w+)\s*=\s*"?([^"#\n]*)"?', line)
                if m:
                    kb[m.group(1)] = m.group(2).strip()

raw_layouts = [x.strip() for x in kb.get("XKBLAYOUT", "").split(",") if x.strip()]
raw_variants = [x.strip() for x in kb.get("XKBVARIANT", "").split(",")]
xkb_model = kb.get("XKBMODEL", "").strip()
xkb_options = [x.strip() for x in kb.get("XKBOPTIONS", "").split(",") if x.strip()]

primary_layout = raw_layouts[0] if raw_layouts else "us"
primary_variant = raw_variants[0] if raw_variants and raw_variants[0] else ""

keymaps = []
seen = set()

def add_keymap(layout, variant="", include_sys_opts=False):
    if not layout or layout in seen:
        return
    seen.add(layout)
    entry = {"name": layout, "xkb_layout": layout}
    if variant:
        entry["xkb_variant"] = variant
    if include_sys_opts:
        if xkb_model:
            entry["xkb_model"] = xkb_model
        if xkb_options:
            entry["xkb_options"] = xkb_options
    keymaps.append(entry)

add_keymap(primary_layout, primary_variant, include_sys_opts=True)
for idx, lay in enumerate(raw_layouts[1:], start=1):
    var = raw_variants[idx] if idx < len(raw_variants) else ""
    add_keymap(lay, var, include_sys_opts=True)
for fallback in ("us", "fr", "es", "de"):
    add_keymap(fallback)

cfg = {
    "shell": bundle,
    "input": {
        "keyboard": {
            "keymaps": keymaps,
        }
    },
}
with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.dump(cfg, f, indent=2)
PY
  then
    PILOTI_GREETER_CONFIG="${RUNTIME_GREETER_CONFIG}"
  fi
fi

if [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; then
  exec domicile "${PILOTI_GREETER_BUNDLE}" "$@"
elif [ -f "${PILOTI_GREETER_CONFIG}" ]; then
  exec domicile "${PILOTI_GREETER_BUNDLE}" --config "${PILOTI_GREETER_CONFIG}"
else
  exec domicile "${PILOTI_GREETER_BUNDLE}"
fi

# piloti-webapp — Launch a URL as a standalone Piloti Web App window
set -eu

if [ "$#" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "Usage: piloti-webapp <url>" >&2
  exit 2
fi

exec /usr/bin/piloti open --app "$@"
